items.title: 10.2 Magnetic flux aur flux density (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.2 in the book's order (PDF 232-233), with Example 10.2 and a self-check.

blocks.text: Jaise electric field ko lines se dikhate hain, waise hi magnetic field B ki taqat ko bhi lines of force se dikha sakte hain. Field ke perpendicular rakhi kisi satah (surface) ke fi unit raqbe (area) se jitni lines guzarti hain, woh magnetic flux ko zahir karti hain. Yani:

blocks.title: Magnetic flux
blocks.text: Kisi raqbe A ke tukre se magnetic flux us raqbe se guzarne wali magnetic lines ki tadaad hai.
Agar B field ke perpendicular rakhe unit raqbe se guzarne wali lines ki tadaad ho, to field ke perpendicular raqbe A ke liye:

blocks.alt: Ufuqi magenta field lines, B, daen taraf ek jhuke hue peele hamwar raqbe se guzarti hain. Raqbe se hara vector A, us ka amud (normal), field ki simt (dashed lakeer) se zawiya θ par oopar uthta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.5: Hamwar raqba A jis ka amud B se zawiya θ banata hai (kitab ki Figure 10.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Raqbe ka amud (normal) A, field B se θ zawiya banata hai. Jitni lines raqbe se guzarti hain woh raqbe ke us hisse par munhasir hain jo field ke amudi nazar aata hai, is liye flux = BA cosθ.

Ho sakta hai satah A field ke perpendicular na ho, yani satah ka normal (satah par seedhi khari lakeer) B se zawiya θ banaye (Fig. 10.5). Tab hum B ka woh hissa (component) lete hain jo vector area A ke saath hai, yani B cosθ (Fig. 10.6). Is liye satah se guzarne wala flux:

blocks.alt: Vector B ufuqi daen taraf; vector A usi nuqte se zawiya θ par oopar. B ke sire se A par amudi dashed lakeer; A par us nuqte tak ka hissa B cosθ hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.6: B ka vector area A ke saath juz B cosθ (kitab ki Figure 10.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: B ko do hisson mein torein: A ke saath wala hissa B cosθ aur A ke amudi hissa. Sirf A ke saath wala hissa raqbe se guzarta hai, is liye ϕ_B = (B cosθ) A = B.A.
B aur A dono vectors hain, is liye yun bhi likh sakte hain:
Eq. (10.6) batati hai ke ϕ_B scalar quantity (sirf miqdar, simt nahi) hai (kitab mein 'scaler' chhapa hai). Is liye magnetic flux ki tareef yeh hai:

blocks.title: Magnetic flux
blocks.text: Uniform magnetic field B mein raqbe A ke hamwar (plane) tukre se magnetic flux ϕ_B, B aur A ka dot product hai.

A aisa vector hai jis ki miqdar tukre ka raqba hai aur simt satah ke normal ki taraf; θ, B aur A ke darmiyan zawiya hai (Fig. 10.5). Fig. 10.7(a) mein field raqbe ke normal ki taraf hai, to θ = 0 (cos0° = 1) aur flux sab se zyada, BA ke barabar hai. Jab field raqbe ki satah ke parallel ho (Fig. 10.7(b)), to field aur normal ka zawiya 90° hai (cos90° = 0), is liye flux zero hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Peela raqba ufuqi field lines B ke aar paar khara hai aur hara vector A field ke saath hai. (b) Peela raqba field lines B ke saath leta hua hai aur A seedha oopar, B se 90° par.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.7: (a) Field raqbe ke amud ke saath: flux zyada se zyada; (b) field raqbe ke mutawazi: flux sifar (kitab ki Figure 10.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein A aur B ek hi simt mein hain: θ = 0, cos 0 = 1, sab lines raqbe se guzarti hain, flux = BA. (b) mein raqba lines ke saath leta hai: A aur B ka zawiya 90°, cos 90 = 0, koi line raqbe ko paar nahi karti, flux = 0.
Agar satah mudi hui (curved) ho, to use bohat se chhote chhote tukron mein baant lete hain, har tukra hamwar maan lete hain, aur Eq. (10.5) se har tukre ka flux nikal kar sab jama karte hain.

Tesla ki tareef se magnetic flux ki unit N m A⁻¹ hai, jise weber (Wb) kehte hain. Kitab ke mutabiq Eq. 10.5 se magnetic induction B, B ke perpendicular satah ke fi unit raqbe ka flux hai (yeh baat Eq. 10.4, B = ϕ/A, mein seedhi likhi hai). Isi liye B ko magnetic flux density bhi kehte hain; is ki unit Wb m⁻² hai. Yani magnetic field ki taqat Wb m⁻² ya N A⁻¹ m⁻¹ (tesla) mein napi jati hai.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse (a), (b), (c): har ek mein khari magenta field lines neeche ki taraf aur mustateel loop kinare se peeli patti ki tarah, field ki khari simt se 30, 45 aur 60° par jhuka hua.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.8: Yaksan magnetic field mein mustateel loop ke teen rukh (Example 10.2) (kitab ki Figure 10.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Example 10.2
blocks.problem: Taar ka ek mustateel (rectangular) loop 1.2 T ki uniform magnetic field mein rakha hai. Loop 25 cm lamba aur 20 cm chaura hai. Fig. 10.9 mein dikhaye teen rukhon (orientations) ke liye loop se magnetic flux nikalein.
steps: Raqba A = 20 cm × 25 cm = 500 cm² = 5 × 10⁻² m²
(a) Loop field se 30° par hai, is liye B aur area vector A (loop ka normal) ka zawiya θ = 90° − 30° = 60°

blocks.alt: Teenon rukhon ke liye loop ka kinara, seedha neeche vector B aur loop ke amudi area vector A. Loop B se 30, 45 aur 60° banata hai, aur B aur A ka zawiya 60, 45 aur 30° hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.9: Teenon rukhon mein B, loop aur area vector A ke zawiye (kitab ki Figure 10.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ahem baat: Fig. 10.8 mein likhe zawiye (30, 45, 60°) loop aur field ke darmiyan hain, jabke formula mein θ B aur area vector A (loop ke amud) ka zawiya hai. Chunke A loop ke amudi hai, θ = 90 - (loop ka zawiya): 60, 45 aur 30°. Isi liye (a) mein flux sab se kam aur (c) mein sab se zyada hai.

blocks.caption: Hamwar raqbe se flux
header: B aur normal ka zawiya θ

blocks.prompt: Magnetic flux aur flux density mein farq bataiye; in ka aapas mein kya rishta hai (comprehensive question 10.1)? Coil se flux ke liye magnetic field zaroori hai, magar field hone se flux zaroori nahi; wazahat kijiye (short question 10.9).
blocks.explanation: Flux ϕ_B = B·A scalar hai: kisi raqbe se guzarne wali field lines ki tadaad, unit weber. Flux density B vector hai: field ke perpendicular satah ke fi unit raqbe ka flux, unit Wb m⁻² (tesla). Rishta: ϕ_B = BA cosθ, ya perpendicular raqbe ke liye B = ϕ/A. Agar coil ki satah field ke saath leti ho to B aur normal ka zawiya 90° aur cos90° = 0 hai, is liye field maujood hone ke bawajood coil se koi flux nahi guzarta.

items: Magnetic flux: raqbe se guzarne wali field lines ki tadaad; B = ϕ/A (10.4); ϕ_B = BA cosθ (10.5) = B·A (10.6), scalar. Raqba field ke aar paar ho to flux sab se zyada, field ke saath leta ho to zero.
Flux ki unit weber: 1 Wb = 1 N m A⁻¹. B ko flux density bhi kehte hain: 1 T = 1 Wb m⁻² = 1 N A⁻¹ m⁻¹. Example 10.2: 3, 4.2 aur 5.2 × 10⁻² Wb.
